title: projects-orchestrator audit --json --digest (v1)
description: Governance deltas against the previous run. Consumed by harbor L0-6. This is the ONE consumed verb whose payload is a JSON OBJECT rather than a bare array, so it is the only one that can carry an in-band `schema_version` additively -- see schemas/README.md.

schema_version.description: In-band contract version. Additive within a major; a breaking change bumps this and lands lock-step with its consumers.

changed.description: Whether anything moved since the last digest. False with empty new/resolved is the steady state.

new.description: Findings present now and absent last run.

resolved.description: Findings present last run and absent now. Same item shape as `new`.

text.description: Pre-rendered human summary. Present even when nothing changed.
